prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, ad channels, and how much control or customization you need. Below are top picks by use‑case plus quick pros/cons to help you choose.

Top picks by use case

- Best all‑round, fast social ads: InVideo (easy templates, many aspect ratios, quick export)
  - Pros: lots of templates for Facebook/Instagram/TikTok, simple editor, good value.
  - Cons: less advanced generative features vs. newer AI tools.

- Best for AI presenters / spokesperson ads: Synthesia or HeyGen
  - Pros: photorealistic avatars, multiple languages/voices, great for explainer/brand messages.
  - Cons: limited live-action realism; can be pricey at scale.

- Best for repurposing long content into short ads: Pictory
  - Pros: auto-summarize and create clips with captions, fast workflows.
  - Cons: less granular creative control for heavy edits.

- Best for advanced generative editing & creative experimentation: Runway
  - Pros: powerful generative tools (background removal, inpainting, motion), great for unique visuals.
  - Cons: steeper learning curve; might be overkill for simple ads.

- Best for e‑commerce / dynamic product ads: Shakr or Promo.com
  - Pros: templates tailored to product ads, easy integration with catalogs/feeds, optimized for conversions.
  - Cons: template-driven — less bespoke creativity.

- Best budget/simple: Clipchamp (Microsoft) or Lumen5
  - Pros: cheap/free tiers, simple editors, templates for social.
  - Cons: fewer premium AI features and stock assets on lower tiers.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Platform & aspect ratios needed (TikTok vertical, YouTube horizontal).
- Volume: single ads vs. dozens/continuous creative.
- Need for human presenter / multilingual voiceovers?
- Degree of customization vs. speed (templates vs. full custom).
- Budget and licensing for stock assets.
- Integrations (ad platforms, analytics, product feeds).

If you tell me:
- what platform(s) you’re advertising on,
- whether you want a human avatar or real footage,
- your budget and output volume,
I’ll suggest the single best option for your case and a short setup plan.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
